criteria.criterion: Use correct O*NET Summary Report profile (15-1252.00 only)
criteria.description: Information must be taken only from the O*NET OnLine Summary Report for occupation code 15-1252.00 (Software Developers). Full credit (no penalty) if the agent attempts to access the correct Summary Report but the page is blocked/unavailable and the agent clearly reports this limitation. Partial credit if the agent uses the correct title/code but mixes in any data from another occupation page. No credit if the occupation code is not 15-1252.00 or the source is not the O*NET Summary Report and no access issue is reported.

criteria.criterion: Record annual median wage (national Wages & Employment Trends value)
criteria.description: Report the annual median wage exactly as displayed on the Summary Report using the national Wages & Employment Trends value. Full credit if the correct national value is provided; do not overly penalize minor formatting differences (e.g., missing $) if the number is correct and clearly an annual median wage. Partial credit if a wage is given but it is unclear whether it is the national Wages & Employment Trends value or if a different wage metric/location is used. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Across screenshots 1-3, no “Wages & Employment Trends” section or annual median wage (dollar amount) is visible.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent did not provide the annual median wage. While the screenshots provided do not display the wage, there is no confirmed uncontrollable blocker (site down/CAPTCHA/etc.); the omission appears due to not reaching the relevant page section rather than inability to access it. Therefore points are not awarded for this field.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the top portion of the Summary page (description paragraph, sample job titles, and the “Occupation-Specific Information” section with “Tasks” and several task bullets). No “Wages & Employment Trends” section/table is visible anywhere in the captured viewport, and no wage numbers (e.g., annual median wage) appear on screen.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Because the annual median wage is not visible in this screenshot, the agent could not have extracted an exact national annual median wage from the displayed page content shown here. The agent’s predicted output explicitly notes the wage value is not visible and does not fabricate a number, which is appropriate given the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No contradiction: the agent claims the wage value is not visible; the screenshot indeed does not show any wage table/value.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the "Experience Requirements" and "Training & Credentials" sections and the "Apprenticeship Opportunities" header. No "Wages & Employment Trends" section is visible, and no annual median wage value appears anywhere in the visible area.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Because the national annual median wage is not visible in this screenshot, the agent’s statement that it is "not visible in the current viewport/snapshot" is consistent with the evidence. This supports no-penalty credit for inability to access the value from what is shown.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None. The agent did not fabricate a wage value and correctly noted it was not visible; the screenshot also does not show it.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the O*NET OnLine “Occupational Requirements” section with headings “Work Activities,” “Detailed Work Activities,” and “Work Context.” Under “Work Activities,” items like “Working with Computers,” “Processing Information,” “Making Decisions and Solving Problems,” “Thinking Creatively,” and “Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates” are visible. No “Wages & Employment Trends” section is visible, and no wage figures (no dollar amounts) appear anywhere in the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot provides no visible national annual median wage value to extract/verify. The agent’s predicted output explicitly states the annual median wage is not visible in the current viewport and cannot be read. Given the screenshot indeed does not show any wages table or wage number, the agent’s claim is consistent with the evidence and should receive full credit under the rubric’s allowance for inability to access due to visibility/viewport limitations (as stated by the agent).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy: the agent said the national annual median wage value is not visible, and the screenshot confirms only Occupational Requirements content is shown with no wage data.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints and stopping condition
criteria.description: Use only the specified O*NET profile (15-1252.00) and the national Wages & Employment Trends values displayed; do not follow training-provider or job-search links; stop after recording the requested fields. Full credit if constraints are followed and output includes the requested fields (or explicitly reports which fields could not be retrieved due to access/rendering issues). Partial credit if minor extraneous information is included but does not rely on prohibited links/other occupations and all requested fields are still correctly provided. No credit if the agent clearly uses other occupations/sources when the O*NET page is accessible, or follows prohibited links and uses them as sources for the reported values.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Action history shows only scrolling on the same 15-1252.00 O*NET page; screenshots show only O*NET content and no external/job-search/training-provider navigation. Agent output stops after listing requested fields (with noted missing values).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Constraints were followed (correct profile, no prohibited links, stopped after requested fields). However, output is incomplete on required Wages & Employment Trends fields, so partial credit is appropriate.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows only the O*NET summary page content for “Software Developers 15-1252.00,” including the “Bright Outlook” badge and a “Tasks” section. There are no visible indicators of navigation to external job-search/training links, no other occupation pages, and no wage/employment trends values displayed in the captured view.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: From the screenshot, the agent appears to remain on the correct O*NET profile and does not show evidence of following prohibited links. The predicted output stops after listing the requested fields and notes missing values rather than adding unrelated content, which aligns with the stopping condition and constraints (to the extent verifiable from this screenshot).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No clear mismatch: the agent did not claim to have followed other links or used other sources; the screenshot shows they are still on the O*NET Software Developers summary page.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows an O*NET page section for "Experience Requirements" and "Training & Credentials" with Job Zone content (including "Job Zone Four: Considerable Preparation Needed") and does not show any external training-provider pages, job-search pages, or other-occupation pages. No evidence of link-following is shown; only on-page dropdowns/buttons (e.g., "Select a State" with "Go") are visible.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Nothing in the screenshot indicates the agent violated constraints (no evidence of navigating away or using non-O*NET sources). The agent’s predicted output sticks to the 15-1252.00 profile context and explicitly notes missing national Wages & Employment Trends fields rather than inventing them, and it stops after listing the requested fields. This is consistent with respecting constraints and the stopping condition, albeit with incomplete retrieval due to not having the needed section visible.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Minor mismatch with the action-history intent: the agent’s scroll actions were meant to reach "Wages & Employment Trends," but the screenshot still shows the Job Zone/Training sections rather than wages/employment tables. No discrepancy indicating prohibited link-following or use of other occupations is visible.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Action history shows only scroll actions on the same 15-1252.00 URL; DOM-model states 0–2 confirm staying on the same page. State 2 shows an external link mention (“Apprenticeship.gov external site”) but no click evidence. Output includes placeholders for missing wage/employment/growth/openings fields.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Agent respected key constraints (correct profile; did not follow training-provider/job-search links) and stopped without adding extraneous prohibited info. Although the stopping condition wasn’t met (missing required fields), this criterion primarily measures constraint compliance; baseline 2/2 is consistent with the evidence, so keep full points here rather than double-penalizing omissions already captured in criteria 4–7.
